SecurityEventCategory.description: Security signal families, one per named signal in files/10 §5.

description:
One security event, separated from application logs (files/10 §2).
Every value is id-shaped — structured JSON with ids only (files/10 §2,
§5 Logging; invariant 6): narrative has no carrier here.

actor_ref.description: Acting principal id when one exists (files/10 §5: admin actions, break-glass per actor); None for e.g. integrity failures.
actor_ref.title: Actor Ref

attributes.description: Additional context as id-shaped values only — the value type enforces the ids-only logging rule (files/10 §2; invariant 6).
attributes.title: Attributes

correlation_id.description: Correlation id linking the event to its trace/log context (files/10 §5 Logging: correlation ids; files/08 §8 SafeError {error_code, correlation_id}).
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

resource_ref.description: Affected resource id when one exists (files/10 §5).
resource_ref.title: Resource Ref

schema_id.description: Versioned event id per the TS schemaId convention.
schema_id.title: Schema Id

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant when tenant-scoped; None for platform-level events (files/10 §6 tenant_id propagation).
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
